name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family legacy, but a childhood fascination with the precision and engineering of Formula 1 cars he saw on television. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics, and quickly found work at a small racing outfit in the French Formula 4 series. There, he honed his skills and developed a keen understanding of the intricate interplay between performance and reliability. 

At V8 Masters Racing, Jean-Pierre is the linchpin that keeps everything running smoothly. He approaches his role with a meticulous attention to detail, ensuring every department is synchronized and operating at peak efficiency. While he may not be the loudest voice in the room, his calm demeanor and methodical problem-solving skills make him an invaluable asset. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, making him a trusted confidant and a steady hand during high-pressure situations. Jean-Pierre is unique in his approach to problem solving which involves a lot of data analysis, but also intuition which he developed over many years. He is also always willing to mentor younger members of staff.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly parted to the side
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a slim build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking black coffee, no sugar, no milk, at exactly 10:00 AM every day.
